newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM takes NLG 290 mln restructuring charge.
newsitem.headline: KLM takes NLG 290 mln restructuring charge.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Wednesday it was setting aside 290 million guilders in pretax provisions for non-recurring restructuring costs.
"The provision is included in operating income," the carrier said in a statement.
"(Full year) Operating income showed a profit of 89 million guilders before the charge and...a loss of 201 million guilders after provisions," it said.
KLM unveiled its Focus 2000 programme last November, aimed at hiking operating profits by 1.5 billion guilders in three years.
It said the provisions for Focus 2000 included 70 million guilders "for necessary software adjustments" related to the year 2000.
Analysts had forecast restructuring charges of 150-200 million guilders.

KLM earlier reported that 1996/97 net profit for the year ended March 31, 1997 nosedived to 236 million guilders after taking a one-off restructuring charge of 290 million guilders, from 547 million in 1995/96.
